audit.whatIsWrong: Stored rows read Skill, Tahm Kench, Tahm Kench, Skill, Skill, Tahm Kench, Tahm Kench — which hands Tahm the late game. The early paragraph says 'Tahm Kench wins levels 1-4', whys[4] says level 6 is 'flipping it to you', whys[5] 'favouring you' and whys[6] 'keeping it yours'.
audit.why: The packet levelChart (Tahm Kench x4, then Vladimir x3) matches the prose on all seven rows. Five stored rows contradict their own explanation text, and the page currently tells the reader Tahm wins first item and two items while the paragraph under it says Vladimir does.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 and 3 become Tahm Kench; rows 4, 5 and 6 become Vladimir. Rows 1 and 2 are already correct.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags zero sequencing cues — no cooldown appears anywhere — and spikes[1] calls his ultimate 'Abyssal Dive/Devour', merging two different abilities.
audit.why: Abyssal Dive is W (21s at rank 1, 1000-1200 range, knockup). Devour is R and has NO cooldown at all — it costs 100 mana and requires three An Acquired Taste stacks on the target. Calling it a roam tool on a cooldown misses that it is available on demand the moment you are stacked. Tongue Lash is 7s to 5s at 900 range; Thick Skin is a 3s cooldown.
audit.corrected: Devour: no cooldown, gated by 3 stacks. Abyssal Dive: 21s at rank 1. Tongue Lash: 7s at rank 1, 5s at rank 5.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors, both repeated. (1) The page credits 'grey health' to his passive in whys[0], spikes[0].text, spikes[1].text, early, mid and wants.foe[1]. An Acquired Taste is the stack counter that enables Devour plus health-scaled attack damage; the damage-storing grey health is Thick Skin (E). (2) Tongue Lash is called a 'slow-stun' as if it always stuns. Riot's text: it slows and heals him, and stuns ONLY if the target already has 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste.
audit.why: Both are the same missing mechanic — the stack counter. The stun and the ult are gated behind three stacks, so the entire matchup is about not accumulating them, and no field on the page says the counter exists.
audit.corrected: Every hit from Tahm applies a stack of An Acquired Taste. At 3 stacks his Q stuns and Devour becomes castable on you. Break the chain of hits and neither happens. Thick Skin (E, 3s) banks a share of the damage you deal and converts it to a shield — chip poke feeds it, so commit to burst instead. Tongue Lash also heals him, so Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades. Tides of Blood is blocked by enemy units, so charge it inside your own wave.

edits.before: - Tahm Kench Tongue Lash: matchup-defining — His stun. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Tongue Lash: 900 range, 7s at rank 1, 5s at rank 5 — it only STUNS at 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste, otherwise it slows. - Abyssal Dive: 21s. - Devour: no cooldown at all, but it needs those 3 stacks.

notes: The mirror (tahmkench side) recorded the single most important correction and it applies here too: Sanguine Pool's 2 seconds of untargetability dodges a CAST, it does not escape a stun or a suppression that has already applied. This page's tldr, winCon, report[1] and dosFull[2] all read 'pool his dive' as if the pool were an escape from a landed combo. I did not rewrite those four strings because each needs its own length-banded pass, but they teach the wrong reflex and are worth a champion-level fix. Also note the whole page is titled 'Track: Tahm Kench Tongue Lash' when the thing to track is the An Acquired Taste stack count, not a cooldown.
